Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4296188. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296188', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
